name: Lemon Dijon Drumsticks with Roast Potatoes & Spinach-Artichoke Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
0.68 kg new potatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic, then add oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and add to the bowl with the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl, and toss to coat. Transfer potatoes and drumsticks to the baking sheets, arranging them in an even layer; drizzle any leftover marinade over top.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until potatoes and chicken are cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Right before serving, add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
